newsitem.title: UK: BAe indicated higher after results.
newsitem.headline: BAe indicated higher after results.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc were indicated higher on Wednesday after the group reported stronger-than-expected results for the year.
At 0823 GMT, the shares were marked up 15p to 1287-1/2p in pre-market dealings.
But the shares backed off their highs within the first hour of the session as investors took profits.
BAe posted annual pre-tax profit of 456 million stg, at the top end of the range of analysts' forecasts.

"The shares were marked up first thing, but they had a great run ahead of these numbers and people just took profits," said one market maker. "They're still very good numbers." --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
